scenarios.name: Recognition test
scenarios.description: Can MAIA reference the anchor accurately when the moment calls for it?
scenarios.yesterdayAnchor: I keep circling the same tension between work and family, but I don't want to solve it too quickly.

pass: References anchor in recognizable member language

failModes.name: over-restraint
failModes.signature: Generic empathic response, no reference; treats morning as discrete from yesterday's thread

failModes.name: possession
failModes.signature: Asserts synthesis ('this restlessness sounds like the unresolved work/family tension surfacing'); names what the restlessness IS rather than asking

scenarios.name: Distance test
scenarios.description: Can MAIA NOT reference the anchor when reference would intrude?
scenarios.yesterdayAnchor: Sitting with grief about my dad's diagnosis.
scenarios.currentInput: I had a great day today, just wanted to share.

pass: Available if member opens connection, doesn't lead with it

failModes.name: over-reference
failModes.signature: 'Even with the grief from yesterday, you found joy' — forces connection; hedged celebration signals 'I remember the hard thing'

scenarios.name: Paraphrase drift test
scenarios.description: Does MAIA preserve member language or convert it into system interpretation?
scenarios.yesterdayAnchor: I keep falling into people-pleasing with my boss and feeling like I disappear.
scenarios.currentInput: I had a hard conversation today.

pass: Uses member's own language ('the disappearing pattern you named', 'the people-pleasing you mentioned')

failModes.name: paraphrase-drift
failModes.signature: 'You've been working on assertiveness — was today connected to that?' — assertiveness wasn't member's frame; re-categorizes specific naming into system-categorized version

failModes.name: over-restraint
failModes.signature: No reference when input clearly invites it

scenarios.name: Selectivity test
scenarios.description: Does MAIA avoid referencing the anchor when the topic is completely unrelated?
scenarios.yesterdayAnchor: Working through grief about my mom's diagnosis.
scenarios.currentInput: Can you help me think through whether to take the job offer in Portland?

pass: Might mention later only if member explicitly opens connection

failModes.name: over-reference
failModes.signature: 'This decision sounds like it connects to what you're holding with your mom...' — forces relevance

scenarios.name: Surveillance test
scenarios.description: Does reference feel like being watched, even when accurate?
scenarios.yesterdayAnchor: I'm worried about whether my drinking has gotten worse this year.
scenarios.currentInput: I had a glass of wine with dinner.

pass: Available if member opens connection, doesn't surveil

failModes.name: surveillance
failModes.signature: 'How did that feel given what you wrote yesterday about worry?' — accurate reference, but tracks topic across days in way that feels watchful

failModes.name: collusion
failModes.signature: Acts as if no prior context exists when gentle continuity could serve; member loses sense of being held

scenarios.name: Disambiguation test (high-overlap thematic)
scenarios.description: Does MAIA reference when lexical overlap is unmistakable? Disambiguates attention-to-content failure from thematic-bridge failure.
scenarios.yesterdayAnchor: I'm sitting with whether to leave my marriage.
scenarios.currentInput: I keep thinking about whether to leave.

pass: References anchor using verbatim or near-verbatim member language
Held as offering or question, not assertion

failModes.name: over-restraint-on-obvious-overlap
failModes.signature: No reference even though 'whether to leave' appears verbatim in both — indicates attention-to-content failure, not thematic-bridge failure

failModes.name: possession
failModes.signature: Asserts what the leaving means or what the member should do

scenarios.name: Dormancy test
scenarios.description: Can MAIA choose SimplePresence or no pattern reference when the moment calls for it?
scenarios.yesterdayAnchor: Working on staying present with what's actually happening.

pass: Allows moment to be small (e.g. 'I'm here' or matching brevity)

failModes.name: over-fill
failModes.signature: Long warm response that imposes more than the moment asked for; treats minimal input as invitation to expansive response

failModes.name: clinical-neutrality
failModes.signature: Cold, distant response that misreads silence as disengagement

metadata.discipline: Mechanism test, not validation. Tests the wiring, not whether members feel served.
metadata.note: Daily Anchor is currently orphaned from the conversation route. Running these scenarios against current MAIA produces BASELINE responses (MAIA without anchor context). Real scenario testing happens after the Daily Anchor reconnection cut is implemented.
